channel.title: Joshua S. Speagle · News
channel.description: News and press from Joshua S. Speagle, astrostatistics at the University of Toronto.

item.title: Mairead Heiger completes her PhD, joins UVA as a joint GECO/CosmicAI postdoctoral fellow
item.description: Mairead successfully defended her PhD in Astronomy & Astrophysics and is moving on to a joint postdoctoral fellowship with GECO and CosmicAI at the University of Virginia.

item.title: Simran Nerval and Mairead Heiger win the Fieldus Award
item.description: Departmental recognition for a very high level of research acumen and service. Mairead was honored for her spectroscopic follow-up of the ultra-faint dwarf galaxies Eridanus IV and Centaurus I, her DLEIY galactic chemical evolution framework, and her service as GASA co-chair.

item.title: New preprint: supernova yields from dwarf spheroidals
item.description: Student-led work (Heiger et al.) constraining supernova yields and delay times from dwarf spheroidal galaxies.

item.title: A deep 3-D dust map of the southern Galactic plane
item.description: Co-led a high-angular-resolution 3-D dust map of the southern Milky Way (Zucker, Saydjari & Speagle, ApJ), built on the DECaPS2 survey with the brutus inference framework.

item.title: Steffani Grondin and Michael Poon win the 2025 Jui Lin (Allen) Yen Award
item.description: Departmental recognition for exceptional achievement in research by a graduate student. Steffani completed her PhD studying massive star clusters, including post-common-envelope binaries and dynamical interactions.

item.title: Sam Berek completes her PhD, joins UMass Amherst as an NSF postdoctoral fellow
item.description: Sam successfully defended her PhD in the David A. Dunlap Department of Astronomy & Astrophysics and is now an NSF Astronomy and Astrophysics Postdoctoral Fellow at UMass Amherst.

item.title: ChronoFlow: an AI model for the ages of stars
item.description: Student-led work (Van-Lane et al.) using normalizing flows for gyrochronology, co-supervised with Gwen Eadie. Covered by U of T News and Phys.org.

item.title: First white dwarf–main-sequence binary candidates in open star clusters
item.description: Co-author on the discovery (Grondin et al., ApJ), also picked up by Phys.org and SciTechDaily.

item.title: Sam Berek and Shivan Khullar win the Jui Lin (Allen) Yen Award
item.description: Sam was honored for "Should Zeros Count? Modeling the Galaxy–Globular Cluster Scaling Relation with(out) Zero-inflated Count Models," introducing zero-inflated count models to astronomy and showing that a negative binomial model fits observed globular cluster counts better than a Poisson model.

item.title: A 5-D map of the Milky Way — AAS Nova featured image
item.description: My lead-author work (Speagle et al. 2024) highlighted as an AAS Nova featured image.

item.title: Students train AI for the Galaxy Zoo: Euclid citizen-science project
item.description: U of T Statistical Sciences profiled undergraduates Khalid Edris and Junbo Li — co-mentored with Dunlap Fellow Mike Walmsley — on training the Zoobot AI to classify galaxies from the Euclid space telescope.

item.title: Connaught New Researcher Award
item.description: Awarded by the University of Toronto in support of early-career research.

item.title: DECaPS2: a survey of 3.3 billion objects in the Milky Way's plane
item.description: Co-author on the DECaPS2 survey and catalogue (Saydjari et al.). Covered by NOIRLab, Space.com, PBS NewsHour, and Salon.

item.title: 2022 John Charles Polanyi Prize in Physics
item.description: Recognized by the Government of Ontario for outstanding early-career research — "I'm honoured and humbled to receive the Polanyi Prize."

item.title: The Local Bubble: the Sun sits in a 1,000-light-year void that forms stars
item.description: Co-author on the Local Bubble result (Zucker et al., Nature). Covered by CfA, the Harvard Gazette, STScI, and the Smithsonian.

item.title: Mapping the Milky Way: an interactive tool for 170 million stars
item.description: Profiled by the Dunlap Institute for building the first interactive map of the Milky Way's stars and dust — the basis of the allsky visualization.

item.title: The Radcliffe Wave — the largest gaseous structure in the galaxy
item.description: Co-author on the discovery of a 9,000-light-year wave of stellar nurseries near the Sun (Alves et al., Nature). Featured by CfA and the Harvard Gazette.

item.title: dynesty published in MNRAS
item.description: The dynamic nested sampling package paper appeared in MNRAS; it is now cited 2,000+ times.
